title: Home for the Holidays: Thanksgiving Week Game Night
shortDescription: Tuesday, November 24 game night at WesCo with Four Dogs. Planned for 7 PM; start time may be adjusted.
description: Get everyone together for a Thanksgiving week game night on Tuesday, November 24. Join Four Dogs at WesCo Brew & Bowl for Home for the Holidays, a drop-in event featuring quick rounds of Survey Showdown, Name That Tune, Finish the Lyric, and other crowd-friendly challenges. Friends, visiting family, and regular teams are welcome. The current start time is 7 PM and may be adjusted; check this event page for updates before heading out.

admission.note: Free admission. Food and drinks sold separately.

instructions: Come ready to play. No advance registration is required. Start time is currently planned for 7:00 PM and may change; check this page for updates. Food and drinks are purchased separately.
